nodes.label: High-Zoom Rendering (Preview + Detail Canvas)
nodes.rationale: One viewport-clipped detail canvas per page instead of tiles, because pdf.js processes the whole operator list per call; memory caps 4 MP / 12 MP / 16 MP.

nodes.label: dist/PDF-Editor.html (single-file build)
nodes.rationale: Internal component: script, styles, fonts and pdf.js worker embedded; not shipped standalone because browser lacks desktop protections.

nodes.label: Regression Tests (legacy vs dist comparison)
nodes.rationale: Every scene runs against legacy 1.0 and the new build; intentional deviations must be replaced by functional checks.

nodes.label: Desktop-App (Electron)
nodes.rationale: Shipped product; loads the single-file editor via app:// scheme with strict security settings.

nodes.label: Release / Auto-Release GitHub workflows
nodes.rationale: A release is produced solely by bumping the version in package.json; actions pinned to commit SHAs.

nodes.label: Aktive Inhalte beim Speichern entfernen
nodes.rationale: JavaScript, Launch links, form submission and embedded files are stripped on save so they are not passed on from supplied datasheets.

nodes.label: Content limits for malicious pages (8 MB, 1.5M ops)
nodes.norm_label: content limits for malicious pages (8 mb, 1.5m ops)
nodes.rationale: Oversized/complex pages are shown view-only so the editor reports instead of hanging.

nodes.label: Generic AI Design Patterns
nodes.rationale: Purple/blue gradients, three equal cards, Lucide icons etc. are AI design fingerprints to be replaced.

nodes.label: Fix Priority Order
nodes.rationale: Font swap first (biggest impact, lowest risk), then palette, states, layout, components, empty/error states, typography polish.

nodes.label: Redesign Rules (keep stack, don't break functionality)
nodes.norm_label: redesign rules (keep stack, don't break functionality)

nodes.label: Scan-Diagnose-Fix Workflow
nodes.rationale: Improve the existing stack with targeted upgrades instead of rewriting from scratch.

nodes.label: Desktop Bridge (File System Access API emulation)
nodes.norm_label: desktop bridge (file system access api emulation)
nodes.rationale: Chromium's native FS Access API is avoided: no handle for command-line files and permission prompts without UI in Electron.

nodes.label: Formularfelder ausfüllen und anlegen
nodes.rationale: Uses stored field appearances for Acrobat-identical rendering; no JavaScript actions for security.
